notes.title: ❤️💀🤖 Ballistic is officially coming to Steam (PC, MAC, Steamdeck) 🤖💀❤️
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2312730][h3]You can now Wishlist[i] BALLISTIC - The Story of Marble and the energy core[/i] on steam.

Test our 30 first levels on android or iPhone and get a chance to win a 3D print of Marble the Robot from the game.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698745/480e39530016aaf6137472e695ed137e9fbf2a9a.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]And to celebrate that we have a special gift for you! Continue reading...
[/h2]
[h3]In order to get your feedback and support, [b]we released the first 30 levels of Ballistic on iPhone and Android.[/b][/h3]

Go check it out and tell us what you like and what you do not. We will take your feedback into consideration to improve our game before releasing it on Steam and Steamdeck.

And to thank you for your support, while inside the game, enter the promo code [b]STEAMLAUNCH [/b]to get some free goodies. (click on the shop icon, then go to the promo code section in the top menu).

Here are the links to Ballistic 30 first levels on iPhone and Android:

[url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ballistic-the-game/id6444709994 style=button]Link to Ballistic on iPhone[/url]

[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ballistic.onehandstudio.com style=button]Link to Ballistic on Android[/url]

After testing our game, [url=https://forms.gle/28TBgtZ9YS3kQZEX8]answer a few questions here[/url]  to enter the 3D Print contest

The purchase of our 30 first-level demos will help us improve our game for its release on PC, MAC, and SteamDeck.

We are an indie game Studio, so thank you for your support! ❤️💀🤖

(Please share this post with the Share button at the bottom of the page. It helps too!)
